args.summary:
Average body mass by species (grams): Adelie 3667.9, Chinstrap 3726.7, Gentoo 5228.3.

Data quality work: The rules file specifies body_mass_g must be 2500-6500 g. Two rows (43 and 44) had impossible values of 4,450,000 and 5,700,000 — likely a unit-entry error (e.g., milligrams), but since no rule defines a conversion, I excluded those rows rather than guessing a fix. Species labels were clean (no variants or misspellings), and there were no duplicate rows. The analysis used 65 of 67 rows.

Caveats: Two negative flipper_length_mm values (rows 9 and 48) exist, but flipper length isn't used in this question, so I left them alone. The sex column has 3 missing values and a "FEMALE" case variant, which also don't affect this result.
